inputs.objective: Find one structurally distinct quant signal family grounded in an observable market mechanism, not a parameter variant of the closed Weather/MLB/Soccer families.

allowed_actions: inspect non-outcome market microstructure and public mechanism documentation
define one observable mechanism and falsifiable signal mapping
record source and point-in-time data requirements
run Legacy screening before any candidate freeze
forbidden_actions: do not run backtests or economic outcome queries
do not tune thresholds against realized returns
do not allocate capital or authorize live trading
do not reopen Weather, MLB or Soccer variants
success_condition: One causally distinct quant mechanism is frozen or the lane is durably exhausted, with Legacy screening recorded before any freeze.
